verses.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα μεγάλης φωνῆς ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ λεγούσης τοῖς ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλοις Ὑπάγετε καὶ ἐκχέετε τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας τοῦ θυμοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēkousa megalēs phōnēs ek tou naou legousēs tois hepta angelois Hypagete kai ekcheete tas hepta phialas tou thymou tou Theou eis tēn gēn
verses.literal: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels Go pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God’s wrath
verses.literalPt: E OUVI, vinda do templo, uma grande voz, que dizia aos sete anjos: Ide, e derramai sobre a terra as sete taças da ira de Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐγένετο ἕλκος κακὸν καὶ πονηρὸν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς ἔχοντας τὸ χάραγμα τοῦ θηρίου καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας τῇ εἰκόνι αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai apēlthen ho prōtos kai execheen tēn phialēn autou eis tēn gēn kai egeneto helkos kakon kai ponēron epi tous anthrōpous tous echontas to charagma tou thēriou kai tous proskynountas tē eikoni autou
verses.literal: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth and loathsome malignant sores broke out on those . . . who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image
verses.literalPt: E foi o primeiro, e derramou a sua taça sobre a terra, e fez-se uma chaga má e maligna nos homens que tinham o sinal da besta e que adoravam a sua imagem.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ δεύτερος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἐγένετο αἷμα ὡς νεκροῦ καὶ πᾶσα ψυχὴ ζωῆς ἀπέθανεν τὰ ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho deuteros execheen tēn phialēn autou eis tēn thalassan kai egeneto haima hōs nekrou kai pasa psychē zōēs apethanen ta en tē thalassē
verses.literal: And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea and it turned to blood like that of the dead and every living thing in the sea died
verses.literalPt: E o segundo anjo derramou a sua taça no mar, que se tornou em sangue como de um morto, e morreu no mar toda a alma vivente.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ τρίτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς ποταμοὺς καὶ τὰς πηγὰς τῶν ὑδάτων καὶ ἐγένετο αἷμα
verses.transliteration: Kai ho tritos execheen tēn phialēn autou eis tous potamous kai tas pēgas tōn hydatōn kai egeneto haima
verses.literal: And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water and they turned to blood
verses.literalPt: E o terceiro anjo derramou a sua taça nos rios e nas fontes das águas, e se tornaram em sangue.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα τοῦ ἀγγέλου τῶν ὑδάτων λέγοντος Δίκαιος εἶ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν ὁ Ὅσιος ὅτι ταῦτα ἔκρινας
verses.transliteration: Kai ēkousa tou angelou tōn hydatōn legontos Dikaios ei ho ōn kai ho ēn ho Hosios hoti tauta ekrinas
verses.literal: And I heard the angel of the waters say Righteous are You O Holy One who is and was because You have brought these judgments . . .
verses.literalPt: E ouvi o anjo das águas, que dizia: Justo és tu, ó Senhor, que és, e que eras, e santo és, porque julgaste estas coisas.

verses.original: ὅτι αἷμα ἁγίων καὶ προφητῶν ἐξέχεαν καὶ αἷμα αὐτοῖς δέδωκας πιεῖν ἄξιοί εἰσιν
verses.transliteration: hoti haima hagiōn kai prophētōn exechean kai haima autois dedōkas piein axioi eisin
verses.literal: For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets and You have given them blood to drink as they deserve
verses.literalPt: Visto como derramaram o sangue dos santos e dos profetas, também tu lhes deste o sangue a beber; porque disto são merecedores.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου λέγοντος Ναί Κύριε ὁ Θεός ὁ Παντοκράτωρ ἀληθιναὶ καὶ δίκαιαι αἱ κρίσεις σου
verses.transliteration: Kai ēkousa tou thysiastēriou legontos Nai Kyrie ho Theos ho Pantokratōr alēthinai kai dikaiai hai kriseis sou
verses.literal: And I heard the altar reply Yes Lord God Almighty true and just are Your judgments
verses.literalPt: E ouvi outro do altar, que dizia: Na verdade, ó SENHOR Deus Todo-Poderoso, verdadeiros e justos são os teus juízos.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ τέταρτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ἥλιον καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ καυματίσαι τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἐν πυρί
verses.transliteration: Kai ho tetartos execheen tēn phialēn autou epi ton hēlion kai edothē autō kaumatisai tous anthrōpous en pyri
verses.literal: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun and it was given power . . . to scorch the people with fire
verses.literalPt: E o quarto anjo derramou a sua taça sobre o sol, e foi-lhe permitido que abrasasse os homens com fogo.

verses.original: καὶ ἐκαυματίσθησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι καῦμα μέγα καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἔχοντος τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τὰς πληγὰς ταύτας καὶ οὐ μετενόησαν δοῦναι αὐτῷ δόξαν
verses.transliteration: kai ekaumatisthēsan hoi anthrōpoi kauma mega kai eblasphēmēsan to onoma tou Theou tou echontos tēn exousian epi tas plēgas tautas kai ou metenoēsan dounai autō doxan
verses.literal: And the people were scorched by intense heat and they cursed the name of God who had authority over these plagues Yet they did not repent and give Him glory
verses.literalPt: E os homens foram abrasados com grandes calores, e blasfemaram o nome de Deus, que tem poder sobre estas pragas; e não se arrependeram para lhe darem glória.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ πέμπτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον τοῦ θηρίου καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ ἐσκοτωμένη καὶ ἐμασῶντο τὰς γλώσσας αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ πόνου
verses.transliteration: Kai ho pemptos execheen tēn phialēn autou epi ton thronon tou thēriou kai egeneto hē basileia autou eskotōmenē kai emasōnto tas glōssas autōn ek tou ponou
verses.literal: And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast and its kingdom was plunged into darkness and men began to gnaw their tongues in anguish
verses.literalPt: E o quinto anjo derramou a sua taça sobre o trono da besta, e o seu reino se fez tenebroso; e eles mordiam as suas línguas de dor.

verses.original: καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν τὸν Θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐκ τῶν πόνων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἑλκῶν αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ μετενόησαν ἐκ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai eblasphēmēsan ton Theon tou ouranou ek tōn ponōn autōn kai ek tōn helkōn autōn kai ou metenoēsan ek tōn ergōn autōn
verses.literal: and curse the God of heaven for their pains and - sores Yet they did not repent of their deeds
verses.literalPt: E por causa das suas dores, e por causa das suas chagas, blasfemaram do Deus do céu; e não se arrependeram das suas obras.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ ἕκτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμὸν τὸν μέγαν τὸν Εὐφράτην καὶ ἐξηράνθη τὸ ὕδωρ αὐτοῦ ἵνα ἑτοιμασθῇ ἡ ὁδὸς τῶν βασιλέων τῶν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς ἡλίου
verses.transliteration: Kai ho hektos execheen tēn phialēn autou epi ton potamon ton megan ton Euphratēn kai exēranthē to hydōr autou hina hetoimasthē hē hodos tōn basileōn tōn apo anatolēs hēliou
verses.literal: And the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the East . . .
verses.literalPt: E o sexto anjo derramou a sua taça sobre o grande rio Eufrates; e a sua água secou-se, para que se preparasse o caminho dos reis do oriente.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ δράκοντος καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ θηρίου καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ ψευδοπροφήτου πνεύματα τρία ἀκάθαρτα ὡς βάτραχοι
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon ek tou stomatos tou drakontos kai ek tou stomatos tou thēriou kai ek tou stomatos tou pseudoprophētou pneumata tria akatharta hōs batrachoi
verses.literal: And I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs coming out of the mouths of the dragon - - the beast and - the false prophet
verses.literalPt: E da boca do dragão, e da boca da besta, e da boca do falso profeta vi sair três espíritos imundos, semelhantes a rãs.

verses.original: εἰσὶν γὰρ πνεύματα δαιμονίων ποιοῦντα σημεῖα ἃ ἐκπορεύεται ἐπὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς τῆς οἰκουμένης ὅλης συναγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν πόλεμον τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς μεγάλης τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ Παντοκράτορος
verses.transliteration: eisin gar pneumata daimoniōn poiounta sēmeia ha ekporeuetai epi tous basileis tēs oikoumenēs holēs synagagein autous eis ton polemon tēs hēmeras tēs megalēs tou Theou tou Pantokratoros
verses.literal: These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth to assemble them . . . for battle on the great day of God the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Porque são espíritos de demônios, que fazem prodígios; os quais vão ao encontro dos reis da terra e de todo o mundo, para os congregar para a batalha, naquele grande dia do Deus Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ὡς κλέπτης μακάριος ὁ γρηγορῶν καὶ τηρῶν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἵνα μὴ γυμνὸς περιπατῇ καὶ βλέπωσιν τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Idou erchomai hōs kleptēs makarios ho grēgorōn kai tērōn ta himatia autou hina mē gymnos peripatē kai blepōsin tēn aschēmosynēn autou
verses.literal: Behold I am coming like a thief Blessed is the one who remains awake and - clothed so that he will not go naked and let his shame be exposed
verses.literalPt: Eis que venho como ladrão. Bem-aventurado aquele que vigia, e guarda as suas roupas, para que não ande nu, e não se vejam as suas vergonhas.

verses.original: Καὶ συνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν καλούμενον Ἑβραϊστὶ Ἁρ¦μαγεδών
verses.transliteration: Kai synēgagen autous eis ton topon ton kaloumenon Hebraisti Har¦magedōn
verses.literal: And they assembled the kings . . . in the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon
verses.literalPt: E os congregaram no lugar que em hebreu se chama Armagedom.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ ἕβδομος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ἀέρα καὶ ἐξῆλθεν φωνὴ μεγάλη ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θρόνου λέγουσα Γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho hebdomos execheen tēn phialēn autou epi ton aera kai exēlthen phōnē megalē ek tou naou apo tou thronou legousa Gegonen
verses.literal: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple saying It is done
verses.literalPt: E o sétimo anjo derramou a sua taça no ar, e saiu grande voz do templo do céu, do trono, dizendo: Está feito.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένοντο ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί καὶ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας οἷος οὐκ ἐγένετο ἀφ’ οὗ ἄνθρωπος ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τηλικοῦτος σεισμὸς οὕτω μέγας
verses.transliteration: Kai egenonto astrapai kai phōnai kai brontai kai seismos egeneto megas hoios ouk egeneto aph’ hou anthrōpos egeneto epi tēs gēs tēlikoutos seismos houtō megas
verses.literal: And there were flashes of lightning rumblings peals of thunder and a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth so mighty was the great quake
verses.literalPt: E houve vozes, e trovões, e relâmpagos, e um grande terremoto, como nunca tinha havido desde que há homens sobre a terra; tal foi este tão grande terremoto.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη εἰς τρία μέρη καὶ αἱ πόλεις τῶν ἐθνῶν ἔπεσαν καὶ Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη ἐμνήσθη ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ δοῦναι αὐτῇ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto hē polis hē megalē eis tria merē kai hai poleis tōn ethnōn epesan kai Babylōn hē megalē emnēsthē enōpion tou Theou dounai autē to potērion tou oinou tou thymou tēs orgēs autou
verses.literal: The great city was split into three parts and the cities of the nations collapsed And - God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath
verses.literalPt: E a grande cidade fendeu-se em três partes, e as cidades das nações caíram; e da grande Babilônia se lembrou Deus, para lhe dar o cálice do vinho da indignação da sua ira.

verses.original: Καὶ πᾶσα νῆσος ἔφυγεν καὶ ὄρη οὐχ εὑρέθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai pasa nēsos ephygen kai orē ouch heurethēsan
verses.literal: Then every island fled and no mountain could be found
verses.literalPt: E toda a ilha fugiu; e os montes não se acharam.

verses.original: καὶ χάλαζα μεγάλη ὡς ταλαντιαία καταβαίνει ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι τὸν Θεὸν ἐκ τῆς πληγῆς τῆς χαλάζης ὅτι μεγάλη ἐστὶν ἡ πληγὴ αὐτῆς σφόδρα
verses.transliteration: kai chalaza megalē hōs talantiaia katabainei ek tou ouranou epi tous anthrōpous kai eblasphēmēsan hoi anthrōpoi ton Theon ek tēs plēgēs tēs chalazēs hoti megalē estin hē plēgē autēs sphodra
verses.literal: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above And men cursed God for the plague of hail because it was so horrendous
verses.literalPt: E sobre os homens caiu do céu uma grande saraiva, pedras do peso de um talento; e os homens blasfemaram de Deus por causa da praga da saraiva; porque a sua praga era mui grande.
